context.name: Urban trees in wind
context.notes: Licensed real footage. Buildings provide possible fixed references. Tree identity, site conditions, defects, wind, and target occupancy have not been verified. Compare capture quality; this clip has no health or motion ground truth.
context.attribution: Trees in the wind — דוד שי (2022)

warnings: Insufficient stable tracks. Recapture with a clear crown and a textured stationary reference.
A tracking gap longer than half a second makes the held signal unreliable. Recapture or choose clearer regions.
Fewer than three cycles observed. Record longer before interpreting frequency.

brief.summary: This recording does not support a reliable motion comparison. Improve the capture before using it in the inspection queue.
evidence: 171 frames sampled over 14.2 seconds; 12% mean tracking retention.
Camera-corrected projected displacement: 8.0 px peak to peak at 640 × 360 analysis resolution.
A repeatable oscillation frequency was not resolved.
Stationary-reference motion: 4.82 px RMS before correction.
Field context: no target reported; visible concern not reported.
nextSteps: Use a tripod or brace the phone; include a stationary building or post.
Record 20–30 seconds in daylight without zooming or panning.
Select a rigid branch junction and a separate textured reference, then scan again.
limitations: Insufficient stable tracks. Recapture with a clear crown and a textured stationary reference.
A tracking gap longer than half a second makes the held signal unreliable. Recapture or choose clearer regions.
Fewer than three cycles observed. Record longer before interpreting frequency.
Projected pixels are not physical displacement without scale and camera calibration.
One video cannot measure hidden decay, anchorage, probability of failure, or a safe wind threshold.
Motion magnitude and frequency alone do not rank structural safety. No failure probability or certified tree-risk rating is produced.
